packageRules.description: Org security baseline §5: 7-day release-age cooldown before a third-party version is eligible for a PR. Scoped to the datasources that carry third-party code (pypi, github-actions); the first-party Atlan packages are negated because the supply-chain rationale does not apply to releases we publish ourselves and a week's delay would stall the fleet's own release loop. The app-contract-toolkit lane is exempt by construction — it resolves through the custom.regex manager on the github-tags datasource (packageName atlanhq/application-sdk), which this rule does not match. Caveat: Renovate does not apply minimumReleaseAge to the lockFileMaintenance lane, so lock refreshes are not covered by this cooldown.
